stappen: Bring the coconut milk and 200 ml water to the boil, add the rice and cook for about 8 minutes.
Cut the broccoli into pieces and roughly chop the parsley.
Fry the broccoli in a splash of oil for about 5 minutes; add the prawns for the last 3 minutes.
Mix the rice, broccoli, prawns, peas and parsley. Heat for about 2 minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Divide between two plates and serve.
tips: More flavour: fry garlic, fresh ginger and red chilli or sambal with the broccoli, and stir a tsp of curry paste (yellow or red) or some lemongrass into the coconut milk.
Finish with lime juice and zest, and optionally 1 tbsp fish sauce or soy sauce.
Good toppings: roasted cashews, coconut flakes or sesame seeds. Pieces of mango or pineapple also go well.
You can add extra vegetables (pepper, courgette or pak choi), and marinate the prawns beforehand in garlic, paprika and lime.
